messages:
Priya: Quick follow-up from the S3 token-validation outage postmortem — consolidating action items. Top items: improve stale-secret detection alerts, backfill missing audit logs, tighten staging service-account perms. Assigning owners below, please ack.

Jordan: Ack. I will own stale-secret detection alerting. Plan: add a heartbeat check, increase sampling for key rotation events, and add a low-noise severity band. Target: EOD +3. Filed issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ops/issues/1452

Sam: I'll take audit-log backfill. Scope: rehydrate the one-day window of dropped logs and run validation against event counts. Building a small backfill script (python) + verification. ETA: 5 business days. PR will be in ops/audit-backfill.

Alex: I'll handle perms remediation for staging. Found a role-binding giving infra-sa broad access — will narrow to least-privilege and add an integration test that fails CI if wildcard bindings are present. ETA: tomorrow COB.

Priya: Good. Can we add a recurring weekly checklist to security oncall for token TTL drift + secret freshness? I'll add a step in the token runbook: https://confluence.redwood/incident-runbooks/token-ttl-checklist (please review).

Jordan: Noted a recurring pattern: token refresh failures spike during auth-cache miss storms after deploys. Proposal: add cache-warming and a short rate-limiter on refresh endpoints during rollouts. Drafting design: /docs/auth/cache-warmup.md

Maria: FYI incident-bot captured the rollout alert during the event: "deploy v2.14 -> failed health check auth-service". Logs archived to S3: s3://redwood-incident-logs/3509876543/*.log.

Sam: Example log snippet that shows missing JWKS lookedups causing validation gaps:
```
ERROR auth/validator: missing jwks for kid=abc123 request_id=xyz
```
I'll add retry + fallback-to-cache in the validator and include metric emission for missing-jwks counts.

Alex: Pushed a draft policy `restrict-staging-sa.yaml` to oss-templates branch. Will open PR for review and link to GH issue after tests pass.

Priya: Let's meet a quick checkpoint next Tue 10:30am PT to review progress. Owners: please update the linked GH issues with PR links before the checkpoint. :calendar:

Jordan: Ack — I'll add an initial PR by EOD tomorrow.

incident-bot: Reminder scheduled: Security owners checkpoint in 6 days (https://calendar.redwood/3509876543-checkpoint).
